_readme: Owner-curated series cast for Dragon-Devouring Mage, applied to every chapter by cast_builder --series-cast. Only the protagonist is locked: cast_builder filed his real name as a separate 'ally' each chapter, so the name rotation (recap_style.cap_protagonist_name) never rotated 'Russel Raymond' and the identity gate swapped his lines to other characters. No visual_description here, so each chapter keeps its own look.
